{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Yuri Luchko''' is a German professor of mathematics at the [[Berliner Hochschule für Technik|Berlin University of Applied Sciences and Technology]]. His 90 works were [[peer review]]ed and appeared in such journals as the ''[[Fractional Calculus and Applied Analysis]]'' and ''[[Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications]]'', among others.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.it/citations?hl=en&user=aJjMk9QAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&pagesize=100|title=Yuri Luchko|publisher=[[Google Scholar]]|access-date=December 11, 2013}}</ref>
